title: GaggleBundle
description: A versioned, sanitized, portable export of one gaggle's declarative configuration and referenced companion files.

apiVersion.description: Public API version of the bundle envelope.

source.description: Portable source identity, API version, and sanitized definition digest.

exportedAt.description: UTC time when this envelope was exported. It is excluded from the definition digest.

provenance.description: Public exporter provenance and the destination-specific fields removed during sanitization.

definition.description: Canonical typed definitions, referenced companion files, and logical repository requirements.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON encoding of definition. Export timestamps and provenance do not affect it.
Lowercase SHA-256 digest prefixed by sha256:.

name.description: Source gaggle name. It identifies no instance, host, user, tenant, or authorization.

apiVersion.description: API version of the exported source gaggle definition.

digest.description: Digest of the sanitized declarative definition; it must equal the envelope digest.

exporter.description: Public tool that produced the bundle.

exporterVersion.description: Goobers build version that produced the bundle.

exporterCommit.description: Optional public source revision of the exporter build.

items.description: Field path intentionally normalized or omitted because it is destination-specific or non-portable.

sanitizedFields.description: Explicit list of field classes removed or normalized during export; sanitization is never silent.

gaggle.description: Sanitized canonical Gaggle object. Import replaces the portable isolation placeholder with the destination gaggle namespace.

items.description: Canonical Workflow object belonging to the exported gaggle.

workflows.description: Workflows sorted by metadata.name for deterministic export.

items.description: Canonical Goober object belonging to the exported gaggle.

goobers.description: Goobers sorted by metadata.name for deterministic export.

files.description: At most 256 referenced instruction and skill package text files, sorted by path, with at most 1 MiB decoded per file and 8 MiB decoded in aggregate. Shared skill packages are materialized under the imported gaggle.

items.description: Credential-free logical repository identity that must already be authorized by the destination instance.

repositories.description: Primary, additional, and sibling repository identities sorted deterministically. Connection and credential material is never included.

path.description: Slash-separated path relative to the gaggle directory. Absolute paths, backslashes, and traversal are forbidden.

contentBase64.description: Exact UTF-8 companion-file text encoded as base64 after provider-secret, private-key, credential-assignment, credential-URI, binary-control, and host-local-path checks.

sha256.description: Digest of the decoded companion-file bytes.
